title: Conformance vector
description: A pure-function test: resolution, paths, no_proxy matching, rate-limit headers, durations (docs/config.md section 9.2). Each runtime runs every vector as a unit test; no server is involved.

kind.description: Also the directory the file sits in.

code.description: Options set in code, by catalogue name; durations as strings (`5s`), lists as arrays. `http_client: custom` means a caller-supplied client.

env.description: The environment, injected. `{dir}` is the vector's temporary directory.

config_file.description: TOML text written to `{file}` = `{dir}/config.toml` and passed as config_file, unless `home` places it at the OS default instead.

home.description: Write config_file at the OS default location under a home directory of `{dir}/home` instead of passing it; with no config_file, an empty home.

profile_type.description: Resolve for a typed (generated) profile of this name instead of the public client.

cli.description: Whether `cli_path` resolves to an executable; default absent.

expect.description: kind config: a subset of describe() (config.md section 2.6), or the error. Paths compare after `\` becomes `/`; `{dir}` and `{file}` are substituted.

settings_absent.description: Settings that must not appear in describe().

excludes.description: Strings that appear nowhere in describe() or in the error.

checks.description: Kinds other than config: one input and its expected output per item.

expect.description: config-path: the path or null; no-proxy: the proxy URL or null; rate-limit: the snapshot or null; durations: milliseconds or the string `error`. `{ "error": "config" }` where resolution must fail.
